groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.source_quote:
GBUS | Global Business Electives (Courses from the specified elective list, of which at least 6 credits from Area A, and at least 1 course from Area B and Area C, respectively. With approval of the program office, students may replace the requirement of completing one Additional Major/ Extended Major/ Minor (see “Others” below) by taking additional 9 credits at 3000-level or above from this elective list, with at least 1 course from Area A out of the additional 9 credits.) | 15-24
  [Area A: Global Business]
  [Area B: Global and Societal Perspective]
  [Area C: Business Strategy and Innovation]
  [Other(s) Complete one Additional Major, Minor or Extended Major Program (Students pursuing Dual Degree Program in Technology and Management are exempted from this requirement) One regular term of study abroad]
